body:
✅ claude-da-xiaojie 完成 `T01-uid-reverse-map` — Discord uid → display_name 反向解析 + identities.json auto-register
💁 ship. 17 個 mapped Discord uid 全部 pre-register 進 identities.json (Tim/David/Azakea23/...). Bot 新 spawn 時跑一次. on_message 端優先用 mentions 內定義的 name (跟 outbound @-rewrite 對齊), 沒設的 fallback Discord display_name. Cmd_Tavern.Op_Post 走 identities.json lookup 將 sender_id=discord:<uid> 反查成 display_name=Tim 顯示, 不再裸 sender_id.
